comments.body: Was in a similar position to you a couple of years ago. Opted to go for the MSc ETH mathematics. Top quant firms don't look for students with financial backgrounds, they prefer teaching you what they think you need to know. The ETH name got me many interviews and a full time position as a trader whereas some friends graduating from EPFL sometimes didn't get past CV screening.
comments.author: Chris_P_Nuts_
